summary: With the availability defect now asserted, I spent the turn naming the mechanism the claim depends on instead of adding more scenarios, because that is what a further probe must test. Reading the propose-time guard against the observed log gives a mechanism that fits: pendingConfIndex is initialized when a node becomes leader to the last index then present and is only raised when that same leader proposes a configuration change, so a joint-entering change committed under an earlier leader and still unapplied at the current leader leaves alreadyPending false while that leader's tracker is not yet joint - the change that would make it joint is precisely the one sitting unapplied - and the guard's other clause does not fire either, so a second joint-entering change is appended even though every node that has applied the first joint change, or will apply it before the new one in log order, then sees two joint-entering changes with no leave between them. That also explains why the intervening entry in the three rejection events is normal rather than a leave-joint entry: the leader's appliedTo never proposed a leave because the leader never applied the joint change while leading. I recorded this as the investigation's hypothesis and discriminator rather than as knowledge, since it is a source-level derivation fitted to the operands and not an observation of the guard's inputs, and specified the deterministic probe that would settle it: a three-voter prefix where a committed joint change is left unapplied by the leader that proposed it, a new leader whose pendingConfIndex predates that change and whose tracker is not joint proposes a second joint change, and the probe records the propose-time triple (pendingConfIndex, applied, joint) together with the appended entry types and each remaining node's applied sequence and apply outcome, with a control in which the new leader applies the first change before proposing the second and the guard should rewrite the proposal instead. The asserted defect claim and its existing receipt are unchanged by this refinement.
